entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 30398648945512960: position at J2016.0. Distance: Gaia DR3 parallax 15.6585 +/- 0.0232 mas (same row, RUWE 0.92): 63.86 pc, no zero-point correction. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): 111.774, -202.410 mas/yr. Radial velocity from the same row.

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 1.13 +/- 0.02 solar radii from Murgas et al. 2022, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of HD 20329 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022A&A...668A.158M/abstract). Mass 0.9 +/- 0.05 solar masses from Murgas et al. 2022, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of HD 20329 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022A&A...668A.158M/abstract). Temperature 5596 +/- 50 K from Murgas et al. 2022, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of HD 20329 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive.

entries.subject: Colour
entries.finding: A Planck spectrum at 5,596 K, because no archive holds a spectrum of this star (stis-ngsl: HD 20329 is not in the library; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number), through the CIE 1931 2-degree observer: #ffeee4. Routes tried in order: stis-ngsl: HD 20329 is not in the library; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number; planck: used.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 5,596 K and log g 4.29 (u1 0.497, u2 0.236): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.
